rationale_highlights: Mr. Bernard was exposed to all of these disadvantages and challenges, likely from his earliest recollections.
Mr. Bernard’s personal history is reflective of that of his greater community.
I am not prepared to completely abandon rehabilitation as a sentencing goal.
Mr. Bernard is very clearly the product of his cultural and personal history.
The legacy of life as an Aboriginal person must be acknowledged, considered and addressed.
note: Gladue keeps rehabilitation alive; court never says it reduces culpability or parole period

crime_highlights: Kale Gabriel had his loaded gun stuck inside the waistband of his pants.
Kale Gabriel initiated the physical fight with Ryan White by kicking him in the head.
In the course of that fight, Kale Gabriel intentionally shot Ryan White, causing his death.
rationale_highlights: The dislocation of his family, his great grandmother’s time in residential school and the multigenerational disruption of the family have had an impact on his family and on the way that Kale Gabriel was brought up.
There are ways in which he is a product of the residential school system.
Kale Gabriel was a drug dealer with a gun but he didn’t become that by a single act of free will.
But they are also a product of his background and his environment.
note: Court says assessments give context, not justification for a lighter sentence
